waivers: WAIVER(S) REQUESTED: 1. Section 27-132(a): Request to waive requirement for direct access to an arterial or collector street. 2. Section 27-283.12(J): To allow access from non-residential parking lots to a local street at greater than 150 feet of the intersection with an arterial or collector roadway. The West Cleveland Street driveway is located at 200 feet. 3. Section 27-284.3.3: To reduce the 8’ wide VUA/ROW landscape area to 5’ wide with no changes to the required plantings along the west property line. 4. Section 27-284.3.3: To reduce the 8’ wide VUA /ROW landscape area to 3’ wide with no changes to the required plantings along the north property line. 5. Section 27-289.3(D): To allow a freestanding sign setback of 10 feet and an overall height of 17 feet. The code allows a maximum overall height of 15 feet. This would allow for a brand standard height for Culver’s franchising system. 6. Section 27-289.3(5)C: To allow a freestanding sign area of 57.17 SF, including the electronic message center (EMC). The code allows a maximum sign area of 50 square feet per sign face. This would allow for a brand-standard size for Culver’s franchising system. 7. A waiver to allow a mural to be designated as art and excluded from the overall square footage of the building signs, consistent with Chapter 4 – Public Art, Section 4-2, Definitions, “works of art or artworks.”
staffReport.findings: The Development Review and Compliance staff has reviewed the petition and finds the request INCONSISTENT with the applicable City of Tampa Land Development Regulations. See findings from Development Coordination, Transportation and Stormwater in the report below. Should it be the pleasure of City Council to approve the application and waivers listed above, further modifications to the site plan must be completed by the applicant between 1st and 2nd Reading of Ordinance as stated on the revision sheet. These revisions will not resolve the issues of Transportation’s inconsistent finding.
